title: thymus danubialis
intro: Thymus danubialis, commonly known as the Carpathian thyme, is a perennial plant native to the mountainous regions of Europe. It is a member of the Lamiaceae family and is used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits. The plant has been found to have anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including wound healing and the management of respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Thymus danubialis include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
